text:
- rāgatattvaṃ tu karmāvacchinno 'bhilāṣaḥ — passion-principle is action-bounded longing. [tsa-a08-v20] (R) [CLM-001]
- Passion = bounded longing. [tsa-a08-v20] (R) [CLM-002]
- karma tu tatra karmamātraṃ buddhidharmas tu rāgaḥ — action is mere action there; mind-nature is passion. [tsa-a08-v21] (R) [CLM-003]
- karmabhedacitra iti vibhāgo vakṣyate — varied by action-difference; distinction to be told. [tsa-a08-v21] (R) [CLM-004]
- Action mere; passion mind-nature; distinction deferred. [tsa-a08-v21] (R) [CLM-005]
- sa ca malo vijñānakevale vidyamāno dhvaṃsonmukha iti na svakāryaṃ karma āpyāyati — existing in knowledge-kevalin, facing destruction: does not fatten its effect-action. [tsa-a08-v23] (R) [CLM-006]
- pralayakevalasya tu jṛmbhamāṇa eva āsta iti malopodbalitaṃ karma saṃsāravaicitryabhoge nimittam — but yawning in dissolution-kevalin: impurity-strengthened action causes transmigration-variety-enjoyment. [tsa-a08-v23] (R) [CLM-007]
- Knowledge-kevalin starves action; dissolution-kevalin fuels it. [tsa-a08-v23] (R) [CLM-008]
[tantrasara-a08:tsa08-p02]
